captions.read: 30,644 drawing items in the two plan areas, on 38 layers, in millimetres.
captions.sort: Walls 1,290 lines, windows and glass 1,002, stairs 370, door symbols 2,883. 39,463 lines ignored: furniture, floor patterns, grid and dimensions.
captions.align: The upper plan sits beside the ground plan on the sheet. 24 grid labels match on both, so it moves 74.02 m onto the ground plan and rises to its level: ground {groundlevel+} m, upper {upperlevel+} m.
captions.pair: Each wall is drawn as two lines. Pairing them gives 1,495 wall pieces and 2,096 glass pieces; 94% of the ground-floor wall lines and 98% of the upper ones found their partner.
captions.merge: 3,591 pieces merge into 59 wall runs and 11 glass runs: one solid each, no seams. The 32 doors and 37 windows found in the plan are cut through them; window glass goes in each window and in the 3 sliding glass doors that may be windows.
captions.raise: The walls rise to their height: ground floor {groundheight} m, upper floor {upperheight} m. Doors stay open to their heads (ground 3.00 m, upper 2.60 m, from the elevations) with 65 lintels above doors and windows; windows get glass from the sill to the head (ground 3.00 / 3.90 m, upper 2.55 / 2.60 m).
captions.finish: Floor plates and stairs go in, and last the furniture: 76 coloured boxes, one per piece, 9 kinds. Done: 2 floors, 59 wall runs, 11 glass runs; found on the ground floor 19 doors, 16 windows and 8 passages, upstairs 13 doors, 21 windows and 9 passages. The real build takes seconds; this replay slows it down so you can follow it.
